item.title: East-West oil pipeline targeted in Saudi Arabia’s Medina region, sparking fire: Ministry official
item.description: A drone or missile strike reportedly targeted the East-West oil pipeline in Saudi Arabia's Medina region, causing a fire, according to a ministry official. (Source: Anadolu Ajansı)

item.title: UK Government Warning: Critical Infrastructure Organizations Must Be Fully Ready for AI-Powered Malware by 2028
item.description: UK government warns critical infrastructure operators must be prepared for AI-powered malware by 2028, signaling expectations for defensive readiness across essential services. (Source: CPO Magazine)

item.title: CISA, NSA, Australian cyber agencies urge early vendor readiness for PQC transition across critical systems
item.description: CISA, NSA and Australian agencies urge vendors to prepare now for post-quantum cryptography migration in critical systems, including industrial products. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant restores external power supply after blackout
item.description: Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant restored its external power supply after a blackout, a recurring disruption that affects reactor safety systems. (Source: Українська правда)

item.title: ENISA Warns of Cyberattacks Targeting Refrigeration Systems Across Europe
item.description: ENISA warns of a coordinated series of cyberattacks on commercial refrigeration systems across several EU Member States, with new waves reported in early November affecting supermarkets and food supply chains. (Source: Security Affairs)

item.title: CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA, and DOT Urge Critical Infrastructure To Strengthen Industrial Refrigeration and Cold Chain Monitoring Systems Cybersecurity
item.description: U.S. government urges critical infrastructure operators to harden cooling systems after attacks disrupted European supermarkets, raising risk for OT-connected refrigeration and HVAC. (Source: CISA)

item.title: Industrial Defender Adds Network Security Monitoring and Risk Signal™ to Strengthen OT Cybersecurity Posture Across Europe, Africa and the Middle East
item.description: Industrial Defender adds network security monitoring and a Risk Signal capability to its OT security platform for Europe, Africa and the Middle East, giving asset owners new visibility options in those regions. (Source: PR Newswire)

item.title: Rockwell Automation introduce new SecureOT capabilities
item.description: Rockwell Automation has added new SecureOT capabilities to its industrial security offering, extending options for OT defenders. (Source: Engineer Live)

item.title: Electric utilities join industries urging renewal of cybersecurity information-sharing law
item.description: Electric utilities and other industries are urging Congress to renew the expiring CISA 2015 law that provides liability protections for cyber threat information sharing. (Source: Utility Dive)

item.title: Australia’s CISC sharpens critical infrastructure risk guidance, urges stronger cyber and supply chain controls
item.description: Australia's Critical Infrastructure Security Centre has published updated Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program guidance calling for stronger cyber and supply chain controls by operators. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: ESET uncovers Gorbag cyberespionage campaign targeting Ukraine’s administrations, defense sector, transportation hub
item.description: ESET research describes Gorbag, a previously underreported Russia-aligned cyberespionage actor targeting Ukrainian administrations, defense, and a transportation hub. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: CISA urges critical infrastructure owners to prioritize OT security, operational continuity, recovery planning in 2026 campaign
item.description: CISA launched its 2026 Critical Infrastructure Security and Resilience campaign, urging owners to prioritize OT security, operational continuity and recovery planning. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Attackers exploit critical Node-RED flaw to deploy Linux bot and backdoors (CVE-2026-58115)
item.description: Attackers are actively exploiting critical authentication flaw CVE-2026-58115 in Node-RED, a tool built into some industrial control products, to deploy Linux bots and backdoors. (Source: Help Net Security)

item.title: NCSC Chief Warns of Imminent AI Ransomware Threat to UK Critical Infrastructure
item.description: UK NCSC chief warns that AI-enabled ransomware could imminently threaten UK critical infrastructure, urging operators to prepare for accelerated attacks. (Source: Infosecurity Magazine)

item.title: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors
item.description: A CVSS 10.0 missing-authentication flaw in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices is being actively exploited to run remote code, according to VulnCheck. (Source: The Hacker News)

item.title: Industrial Defender Introduces a Unified Approach to NIS2 Compliance and Cyber Resilience Across Industrial Environments
item.description: Industrial Defender introduces a unified approach to NIS2 compliance and cyber resilience for industrial environments, combining OT security and regulatory readiness capabilities. (Source: ACCESS Newswire)

item.title: From Supermarkets to Military Bases: the Cold Chain Cyber Risk Is Heating Up
item.description: Attackers repeatedly manipulated connected refrigeration controls at European supermarket chains, altering freezer temperatures and exposing weaknesses in networked OT systems. (Source: Forescout Vedere Labs)

item.title: Hackers Send Fake Nuclear Threat Alerts to Ukrainian and Russian Citizens
item.description: Hackers reportedly compromised Ukrainian and Russian emergency alert apps to push fake air raid and nuclear warnings to citizens, a public safety disruption affecting government warning systems. (Source: Security Affairs)

item.title: Additional Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)
item.description: Ivanti released patches for two more Connect Secure remote access gateway zero-days chained in attacks since October 1, expanding exposure for widely deployed edge devices used by industrial and critical infrastructure networks. (Source: Rapid7)

item.title: Lumen details Volt Typhoon’s Silent Train framework exploiting zero-days to target US critical infrastructure sites
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs published research on Volt Typhoon's Silent Train framework, which exploits zero-days to target US critical infrastructure sites. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Axonius expands asset intelligence platform to IoT and OT devices, addressing cyber-physical security visibility gaps
item.description: Axonius made general availability of its Cyber-Physical platform extending asset visibility to IoT and OT devices. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Rockwell Automation expands SecureOT capabilities to help OEMs address emerging cybersecurity regulations
item.description: Rockwell Automation added SecureOT capabilities aimed at helping OEMs meet emerging cybersecurity regulations for industrial equipment. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Low-skill pro-Russian hackers sabotage Western plants, water utilities — Bloomberg
item.description: Bloomberg reports low-skill pro-Russian hacktivists have sabotaged Western industrial plants and water utilities, raising operational disruption risk for OT defenders. (Source: The New Voice of Ukraine)

item.title: Korea Ranks 5th Globally in Exposed Industrial Control Systems
item.description: A report ranks South Korea fifth globally for internet-exposed industrial control systems, highlighting real-world exposure of national OT assets to remote attack. (Source: Seoul Economic Daily)

item.title: Partners Group acquires minority stake in software provider Nozomi Networks
item.description: Private equity firm Partners Group has acquired a minority stake in Nozomi Networks, a leading OT and IoT security vendor, signaling continued investor interest in industrial cybersecurity. (Source: PEI Private Equity)

item.title: CIP Security Gains TÜV Certification For EtherNet/IP | Security News
item.description: ODVA's CIP Security extension for EtherNet/IP received TÜV certification, providing independent validation of security capabilities for a widely used industrial protocol. (Source: Security Informed)

item.title: CISA’s new cyber strategy puts America’s critical infrastructure in the spotlight
item.description: CISA's new cybersecurity strategy places critical infrastructure at the center of federal priorities, signaling likely shifts in operator expectations and government support. (Source: ET Edge Insights)

item.title: Chilean cyberattack keeps 103 MW solar plant and battery system offline, raising alarm for South African operators
item.description: A cyberattack in Chile has kept a 103 MW solar plant and battery storage system offline, prompting warnings for South African renewable energy operators. (Source: Green Building Africa)

item.title: South Korea begins cybersecurity inspections of 172 critical infrastructure facilities, including telecom networks
item.description: South Korea has begun cybersecurity inspections of 172 critical infrastructure facilities, including telecom networks, under government oversight. (Source: Digital Watch Observatory)

item.title: Rockwell Automation Introduces SecureOT Capabilities to Help OEMs Address Emerging Cybersecurity Regulations
item.description: Rockwell Automation has introduced SecureOT capabilities aimed at helping equipment makers meet emerging OT cybersecurity regulations. (Source: Press Release Hub)

item.title: OmniTrust launches GridAuth to strengthen device identity and trust management across connected energy grids
item.description: OmniTrust launched GridAuth, a device identity and trust management platform aimed at energy utilities and grid equipment. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
item.description: Attackers exploited a critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw to deploy KeyDrift malware that steals traffic encryption keys, according to Cisco Talos. (Source: The Hacker News)

item.title: SSenStone wins 3 billion won in government R&D funding for OT security
item.description: SSenStone won 3 billion won in government R&D funding to develop OT security technology. (Source: Global Sources)

item.title: Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial systems to sabotage factories, utilities, and food production across the West, Bloomberg reports
item.description: Bloomberg reports Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial control systems to disrupt factories, utilities and food production across Western countries. (Source: Meduza)

item.title: Silent Train: uncovering Volt Typhoon's operational framework for zero-day exploitation and strategic access
item.description: Researchers describe a covert, ephemeral network built by the Volt Typhoon China-linked group after US law enforcement disruption, targeting critical infrastructure operators. (Source: Lumen Technologies)

item.title: SafePay Ransomware Breached Over 600 Critical Infrastructure Organizations, CISA Warns
item.description: CISA warns that the SafePay ransomware group has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations, raising risk of operational disruption for OT-dependent sectors. (Source: CPO Magazine)

item.title: Long-Hidden Flaws Patched in EPICS Research Facility Control Software
item.description: Four EPICS Base control software flaws, found by an autonomous system, were patched; they could let attackers crash processes at particle accelerators and fusion labs. (Source: SecurityWeek)

item.title: CISA Unveils New Strategy to Strengthen National Cyber Defense and Critical Infrastructure Security
item.description: CISA released a new national strategy aimed at strengthening cyber defense and critical infrastructure security, setting direction for operators and federal partners. (Source: CISA)

item.title: US Coast Guard releases NVIC 02-26 to guide maritime operators on cybersecurity plans, IT and OT risk assessments
item.description: The US Coast Guard issued NVIC 02-26, guidance for maritime operators on cybersecurity plans and IT/OT risk assessments, relevant to compliance planning for regulated vessels and facilities. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: MythicRatatoskr: An Yggdrasil-enabled backdoor deployed in a UAC-0099-Sandworm collaboration
item.description: Sandworm and UAC-0099 carried out a destructive wiper attack on a Ukrainian logistics company in 2025, using a new mesh network backdoor, per ESET research. Shows state actors using OT-adjacent destructive tooling against critical infrastructure supply chains. (Source: ESET WeLiveSecurity)

item.title: Cold Chain, Open Control: Exposed Refrigeration Systems Reveal Global Risk
item.description: Forescout Vedere Labs analyzes recent physical and financial disruptions at French refrigeration control systems caused without malware, and flags exposed refrigeration controls as a global risk. (Source: Forescout Vedere Labs)

item.title: SafePay ransomware compromised 600 critical organizations worldwide; urge patching and network defenses
item.description: CISA, FBI and partners warn that SafePay ransomware has compromised about 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide, urging patching and stronger network defenses. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: Accenture, Dragos and SANS Institute launch $10 million initiative to strengthen cybersecurity at US utilities
item.description: Accenture, Dragos and SANS launched a $10M initiative to help under-resourced US utilities strengthen cyber defenses, with free tools, equipment, deployment help and training. (Source: Industrial Cyber)

item.title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
item.description: CISA, FBI and partners issued a joint advisory on SafePay ransomware targeting multiple critical infrastructure sectors, with indicators and mitigations for defenders. (Source: CISA)
